records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Leo,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Summit Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Following up on our kickoff last week — I know a new tool is easy to put off when the week fills up. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project in place is usually the step that makes the rest click. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can also be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm glad to sit with you while you set up that first project.

Best,
Chidi
